{{AnimePokémonInfobox |nickname=Aero |jnickname=プテ |tmnickname=Pte |image=[[File:Aero.png|220px]] |caption=Red's Aerodactyl |location=[[Cinnabar Gym]] |gender=Male |ability={{a|Rock Head}} |nature=Hasty |type1=Rock |type2=Flying |media=special |evolution=1 |numeps1=3 |prevonumicon=TCGP EvoIcon Old Amber |firststagename=Old Amber |secondstagename=Aerodactyl |epnum=PS023 |epname=Make Way For Magmar! |firstevoep=PS026 |firstevoname=Holy Moltres |evo1num=142 |current=[[Party|With Red]] |pokemonname=Aerodactyl |va=no }} '''Aero''' (Japanese: '''プテ''' ''Pte'') is an {{p|Aerodactyl}} that {{adv|Red}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his seventh {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. He was given to Red as a piece of [[Old Amber]] from {{adv|Giovanni}}. As of ''[[PS272|Old Ultima Puts Them to the Test]]'', he is at [[level]] 85, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "alert to sounds." ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}=== [[File:Red and Aero.png|thumb|left|130px|Aero and Red]] When Red first met {{adv|Giovanni}} in ''[[PS023|Make Way For Magmar!]]'', he gave Red an ancient [[fossil]] known as the [[Old Amber]], which contained a DNA sample of an ancient, now extinct Pokémon, as a reward for stopping two {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Magmar}} that were causing a fire at the [[Pewter Museum of Science]]. When Red later encountered {{adv|Blaine}} at the [[Cinnabar Island]] in ''[[PS026|Holy Moltres]]'', they faced with the [[legendary birds|Legendary bird]] {{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Moltres}}, which was under the control of [[Team Rocket]]. Even Red's {{t|Water}} Pokémon [[Gyara]] was unable to defeat the {{pkmn2|Legendary}} {{type|Fire}}, and Blaine realized that to stand a chance against the {{type|Flying}} Pokémon, they needed a Flying type of their own. When seeing Red's Old Amber, Blaine sent him to the Island's [[Cinnabar Lab|laboratory]], where Red was able to revive the Amber into an Aerodactyl. With this new Pokémon on his side, Red was able to make Team Rocket retreat. When Red later met up with Blaine again in ''[[PS034|And Mewtwo Too?!]]'', he joined him in a battle against the Legendary Genetic Pokémon {{adv|Mewtwo}}. Although Mewtwo seemed practically impossible to stop, Red finally managed to use Aero to glide through Mewtwo's {{m|Psywave}} tornado in order to get close enough to send [[Pika]] in with Blaine's [[Master Ball]], successfully catching Mewtwo. In ''[[PS038|Long Live the Nidoqueen?!]]'', Aero battled Giovanni at the [[Viridian Gym]]. When Red was pushed into a corner, he managed to call Aero out and attack [[Giovanni's Beedrill]] with {{m|Hyper Beam}}, knocking him out. Giovanni then switched to his type specialty of {{t|Ground}} Pokémon and had his {{p|Rhyhorn}} use {{m|Tail Whip}} to take Aero out of the fight. As revealed in ''[[PS108|Quilava Quandary]]'', Aero was a part of the team Red used during the [[Indigo Plateau|Pokémon League]]. ==={{MangaArc|Yellow}}=== In ''[[PS068|Jigglypuff Jive]]'', Red tried to get Aero to {{m|fly}} him away from the [[Kanto]] [[Elite Four]], but he was stopped by [[Lorelei]]'s {{p|Jynx}}. He was then defeated alongside the rest of his team. ==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}=== Aero appeared in a fantasy in ''[[PS105|Smeargle Smudge]]'', when {{adv|Bill}} explained to [[Falkner]] that Red was going to take the test to become [[Viridian City]]'s [[Gym Leader]] soon. ==={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}=== Aero appeared in a fantasy in ''[[PS259|Rayquaza Redemption II]]'', when {{adv|Sapphire}} explained to {{adv|Ruby}} that the accomplishments of Red and his team inspired her to train to battle. ==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}=== [[File:Aero Rock Head.png|thumb|left|200px|{{a|Rock Head}} activated]] In ''[[PS274|Double Dealing with Deoxys]]'', Aero battled alongside Pika as his last two Pokémon in his battle against {{adv|Blue}}. Red had Aero use {{m|Take Down}} on {{TP|Blue|Scizor}}, which dealt no [[recoil]] damage due to his {{a|Rock Head}} Ability. Aero followed up with {{m|Dragon Claw}} on Scizor, so Blue switched him out for {{TP|Blue|Rhydon}}. Seeing an opening, Red has Pika attack {{TP|Blue|Machamp}} with an electric attack. To Red's surprise, the attack is suddenly redirected. Blue smirks and reveals that Rhydon has the {{a|Lightning Rod}} Ability, which causes all {{type|Electric}} moves to be redirected towards him. Since Pika's Electric attacks had no effect, Pika jumps into the air and delivers an {{m|Iron Tail}} onto Machamp's head. The battle then ends in a tie. [[File:Aero being attacked by Deoxys.png|thumb|200px|Aero's wings being pierced by Organism No. 2]] [[PS279|Later]] Red sent Aero out in his battle against {{adv|Deoxys|Organism No. 2}}. However, the DNA Pokémon proved to be too strong for the Fossil Pokémon, as he was first badly slugged by Organism No. 2's powerful punch and then had his wings pierced by {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Deoxys|Attack Forme}} Organism No. 2's tentacles. He was soon nearly killed along with Red's other Pokémon while defending his {{pkmn|Trainer}} from Organism No. 2's {{m|Psycho Boost}}. Due to his injuries, Aero was unable to use Fly, and as a result, Red had to temporarily trade [[Blue's Charizard]] into his team to use as aerial transportation. In ''[[PS299|Distant Relation Deoxys]]'' and ''[[PS301|Storming the Forretress]]'', Aero was seen joining Red's other Pokémon, Blue's Charizard, and [[Chuchu]] to take down the ten {{p|Forretress}} that [[Carr]] had placed inside the [[Team Rocket airship]]. In ''[[PS302|Phew for Mew]]'', Aero and Red found themselves petrified by [[Sird]], along with the four other [[Pokédex holder]]s and their Pokémon. ==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}=== In ''[[PS334|The Final Battle VII]]'', Red checked on Aero and the rest of his team to ensure they all survived the petrification caused by {{adv|Mewtwo}} and {{p|Darkrai}}. Soon after, it battled [[Guile Hideout]]'s stolen {{gdis|Battle Tower|III}} Pokémon. ==={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}=== Aero appeared in a flashback in ''[[PS460|All About Arceus IX]]'', when [[Radio Director|Hirō]] explained that he based [[Proteam Omega]] off of Red's team after watching him [[PSs2|train]] on [[Mt. Silver]]. ==={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}=== In ''[[PS607|Blastoise Transforms]]'', Aero flew Red around while he and {{adv|Green}} pursued [[Maxie]] and [[Archie]], who had broken into {{adv|Bill}}'s [[Sea Cottage]] and stolen the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s from him. ==Personality and characteristics== Aero appears to love the outside, as the first thing he did when he got resurrected was to look outside through the window in {{adv|Blaine}}'s laboratory. He is shown to be reckless, as he often rushes into situations without giving it much thought or concern.
